consumer: CCL::BOGUS-THING-P, called by the ordinary printer
capability: process operation 14: object word, NIL -> T or NIL
owner: The current single-Worker CollectorOwner; no serialized host address
accepted: D1 fixnums, fulltag-3 immediates and the canonical NIL/T objects
Exact cons or supported misc-object starts in the active allocated heap or enumerable image regions, with matching lowtag and complete aligned extent
Complete six-cell callable records within the published live value stack
rejected: Other immediate tags, unowned pointers, inactive semispaces, unallocated capacity and image root storage
Interior addresses, mismatched pointer tags, unsupported object headers and truncated extents
invariants: The query does not allocate Lisp objects, collect, move roots or write Lisp memory
An invalid argument is examined without passing it through a collecting operation
Invalid owner metadata is a checked 11 failure, distinct from a false validity result
The query checks object identity, header shape and extent, not transitive field validity, hash-table invariants or native memory ownership
cost: Linear allocation walk up to the candidate object; repeated printing may repeat that walk. No performance equivalence with native area lookup is claimed.
native_antecedents: runtime/wasm32/collector.c: D1 allocation spans and stack callable representation
